prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: Settings now shows credit history beneath the balance in English and Korean, with localized dates, activity descriptions, signed amounts, and clearly labeled refunds. Type-checking passed.

+import pytest
+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models.models import CreditTransaction, User, Workspace
+
+
+def assert_billing(amounts):
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        workspace = session.exec(select(Workspace).join(User, User.id == Workspace.owner_id).where(
+            User.email == "writer@example.com"
+        )).one()
+        transactions = session.exec(select(CreditTransaction)).all()
+        assert workspace.credits == 500 + sum(amounts)
+        assert [t.amount for t in transactions] == amounts
+        assert all(t.workspace_id == workspace.id and t.user_id == workspace.owner_id for t in transactions)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind,cost", [("cover", 15), ("sheet", 20)])
+def test_failed_background_generation_then_success(client, kind, cost):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    project = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []}).json()
+    resource = f"/api/v1/projects/{project['id']}"
+    action, field = "cover", "cover_image_status"
+    if kind == "sheet":
+        character = client.post("/api/v1/characters", headers=headers, json={
+            "project_id": project["id"], "name": "Driver",
+        }).json()
+        resource = f"/api/v1/characters/{character['id']}"
+        action, field = "generate", "sheet_status"
+
+    for failed in [True, False]:
+        FakeGemini.fail = failed
+        assert client.post(f"{resource}/{action}", headers=headers).status_code == 200
+        assert client.get(resource, headers=headers).json()[field] == ("failed" if failed else "completed")
+        assert_billing([] if failed else [-cost])
+
+
+def test_scene_render_failure_then_success(client):
+    headers = signup(client)
+    for failed in [True, False]:
+        FakeGemini.fail = failed
+        response = client.post("/api/v1/scenes/render", headers=headers, json={"prompt": "Night bus"})
+        assert response.status_code == (500 if failed else 200)
+        assert_billing([] if failed else [-12])
+
+
+def test_overlapping_jobs_cannot_spend_the_same_credits(client):
+    from app.core.errors import AppException, ErrorCode
+    from app.services.billing import billing_service
+
+    headers = signup(client)
+    workspace_id = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=headers).json()[0]["id"]
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        workspace = session.get(Workspace, workspace_id)
+        workspace.credits = 15
+        session.commit()
+        jobs = [
+            billing_service.prepare_charge(session, workspace.id, workspace.owner_id, "generate_project_cover_image")
+            for _ in range(2)
+        ]
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        jobs[0].commit(session)
+    with Session(engine) as session, pytest.raises(AppException) as failure:
+        jobs[1].commit(session)
+    assert failure.value.error_code == ErrorCode.PAYMENT_INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS
+
+    FakeGemini.calls.clear()
+    response = client.post("/api/v1/scenes/render", headers=headers, json={"prompt": "Night bus"})
+    assert response.status_code == 402
+    assert not FakeGemini.calls
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        assert session.get(Workspace, workspace_id).credits == 0
+        assert [t.amount for t in session.exec(select(CreditTransaction))] == [-15]
+
+

+    url = "/api/v1/projects/styles/recommend"

+    assert_billing([-1])

+from datetime import datetime
+from uuid import UUID, uuid4
+
+from sqlmodel import Session
+
+from app.db.engine import engine
+from app.models.models import CreditTransaction, WorkspaceMember
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def test_member_sees_entire_workspace_ledger_newest_first(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    reader = signup(client, email="reader@example.com")
+    workspace = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner).json()[0]
+    other = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=reader).json()[0]
+    workspace_id = UUID(workspace["id"])
+    reader_id = UUID(other["owner_id"])
+    path = f"/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/credits/history"
+    assert client.get(path, headers=owner).json() == []
+
+    with Session(engine) as session:
+        session.add(WorkspaceMember(workspace_id=workspace_id, user_id=reader_id))
+        for day, amount, action, target, user in [
+            (2, 15, "refund:generate_project_cover_image", workspace_id, reader_id),
+            (1, -15, "generate_project_cover_image", workspace_id, UUID(workspace["owner_id"])),
+            (4, -5, "augment_worldview", UUID(other["id"]), reader_id),
+            (3, 50, "daily_refill", workspace_id, reader_id),
+        ]:
+            session.add(CreditTransaction(
+                workspace_id=target, user_id=user, amount=amount,
+                action_type=action, timestamp=datetime(2026, 1, day),
+            ))
+        session.commit()
+
+    response = client.get(path, headers=reader)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert response.json() == [
+        {"amount": 50, "action": "daily_refill", "created_at": "2026-01-03T00:00:00"},
+        {"amount": 15, "action": "refund:generate_project_cover_image", "created_at": "2026-01-02T00:00:00"},
+        {"amount": -15, "action": "generate_project_cover_image", "created_at": "2026-01-01T00:00:00"},
+    ]
+
+
+def test_credit_history_conceals_workspace_from_nonmember(client):
+    owner = signup(client)
+    outsider = signup(client, email="outsider@example.com")
+    workspace = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=owner).json()[0]
+    for workspace_id in [workspace["id"], uuid4()]:
+        response = client.get(f"/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/credits/history", headers=outsider)
+        assert response.status_code == 404
+        assert "NOT_FOUND_WORKSPACE" in response.text
